display.purpose: Single Hanzi prompts and answers; make the thing being remembered feel intentional.

body.purpose: Fast scanning for modes, meanings, timing, and feedback without a remote font dependency.

shadows.name: learning-stage
shadows.purpose: Separate the warm learning stage from the dark shell without making individual controls float.

shadows.name: audio-focus
shadows.purpose: Give the large pronunciation control a clear physical target.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Let focus, hover, and feedback feel immediate without delaying rapid repetition.

motion.name: reflex-advance
motion.purpose: Give the learner a short proof moment while keeping the drill moving.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The one decisive action on a status or reveal state.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; min-height: 3.6rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid #f06452; border-radius: 0.7rem; color: #fff7ef; background: #c7483b; font: 760 1.08rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-primary span { color: rgb(255 247 239 / 70%); font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #f06452; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #79cbd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A quiet continuation or retry action below a proof state.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height: 2.55rem; padding: 0 0.85rem; border: 1px solid #d9cdbc; border-radius: 0.65rem; color: #1a2028; background: #ece3d5; font: 900 0.62rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-secondary:hover { border-color: #f06452; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #79cbd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Warm Study Card
components.description: The single focused proof sheet used for active learning.
components.css: .ds-card { min-height: 18rem; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid #303946; border-radius: 1.15rem; color: #1a2028; background: #f6f0e5; box-shadow: 0 1.2rem 3.4rem rgb(0 0 0 / 22%); } .ds-card small { color: #656e78; font: 900 0.62rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 4rem 0 0.35rem; font: 650 4rem/1 'Yu Mincho', serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #1c6470; font: 800 1rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Reflex Choice
components.description: A large answer target that becomes its own feedback surface.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; min-height: 4.25rem; padding: 0.65rem; border: 1px solid #d9cdbc; border-radius: 0.65rem; color: #1a2028; background: #f6f0e5; font: 400 0.84rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-choice b { display: grid; width: 1.65rem; height: 1.65rem; place-content: center; border: 1px solid #d9cdbc; border-radius: 0.35rem; color: #656e78; background: #ece3d5; font-size: 0.64rem; } .ds-choice:hover { border-color: #f06452; } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #79cbd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Listen Control
components.description: An exact-reading playback affordance beside ordinary vocabulary.
components.css: .ds-audio { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; min-height: 2.8rem; padding: 0 0.8rem; border: 1px solid #1c6470; border-radius: 0.65rem; color: #1c6470; background: #d8f1f1; font: 900 0.62rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-audio svg { width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-audio:hover { border-color: #79cbd6; background: #b7e6e9; } .ds-audio:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #79cbd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Surface Navigation
components.description: The quiet mode rail that keeps active practice close at hand.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.2rem; padding: 0.2rem; background: #0d1016; } .ds-nav button { min-height: 2.6rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.55rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.55rem; color: #76818f; background: transparent; font: 900 0.62rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav button:hover { border-color: #4a5665; color: #f6f0e5; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { border-color: #d9cdbc; color: #0d1016; background: #f6f0e5; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #79cbd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sound Preference
components.description: A persistent user-controlled sound state in the global shell.
components.css: .ds-sound { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.35rem; min-height: 2.6rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid #4a5665; border-radius: 0.55rem; color: #79cbd6; background: #151a22; font: 900 0.62rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-sound svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-sound:hover, .ds-sound:focus-visible { border-color: #79cbd6; } .ds-sound:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #79cbd6; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Chinese Learning is a quiet instrument for repeated use: a dark ink workspace holds one warm paper proof sheet at a time. The learner commits to one answer, sees the proof of that answer immediately, and moves on. Vermilion marks the decisive action and the mistake; a cool reading cue marks sound, pinyin, and the path back into the material.

The system is editorial rather than dashboard-like. It uses crisp rails, restrained surface changes, and a small number of highly legible states to make the next decision obvious on a phone. The replacement world intentionally leaves the incumbent beige/green shell behind. It has no dependency on remote fonts, imagery, or network-only decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight ink shell with a single warm paper learning stage.
Vermilion proof marks and cobalt/cyan reading cues used with purpose.
Stable answer rails that paint in place for feedback.
Japanese/Chinese serif display paired with a compact system UI sans.
Sound and exact-reading media are enhancements, never hidden correctness gates.

rules.name: The One Proof Mark Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is reserved for the decision, the mistake, or the single most important call to action on a surface. Do not turn every label into an accent.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Use serif for what the learner is trying to remember; use sans for what the interface is asking the learner to do.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting controls are defined by paper, ink, border, and state color. Motion and depth appear only when they clarify focus, response, or the learning stage.

dos: Do make one prompt, one decision, and one next action dominant in every active drill.
Do keep answer and feedback geometry stable across prompt and result states.
Do pair correctness words with state color; never rely on green or red alone.
Do use local/system font stacks and inline SVG icons so the PWA is complete offline.
Do keep touch targets comfortable and keyboard shortcuts discoverable on desktop.
Do treat exact-reading media as verified only when the canonical mapping is unique.
donts: Don't return to a generic dashboard composition during a high-frequency drill.
Don't add gradients, glass effects, remote fonts, or decorative imagery to the active learning surface.
Don't let answer text, examples, or error copy push the next action below the phone viewport when a compact alternative is available.
Don't use sound as the only correctness signal or block progress on audio playback.
Don't borrow pronunciation from a different Hanzi-reading identity.
Don't fill every surface with vermilion, rounded pills, or implementation-oriented explanatory copy.
